queries: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS overall_average FROM per_event), kept AS (SELECT p.link_to_event, p.average_amount, o.overall_average FROM per_event AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_amount > o.overall_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_kept_average FROM kept) SELECT k.link_to_event, k.average_amount, k.average_amount - k.overall_average AS above_overall_average, k.average_amount - m.mean_kept_average AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS overall_average FROM event_averages), kept AS (SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.average_amount, ea.average_amount - o.overall_average AS above_overall FROM event_averages AS ea CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ea.average_amount > o.overall_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_kept FROM kept) SELECT k.link_to_event, k.average_amount, k.above_overall, k.average_amount - km.mean_kept AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS km ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING COUNT(amount) > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS overall_average FROM event_averages), kept AS (SELECT e.link_to_event, e.average_amount, e.average_amount - o.overall_average AS above_overall FROM event_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.average_amount > o.overall_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS kept_average FROM kept) SELECT k.link_to_event, k.average_amount, k.above_overall, k.average_amount - m.kept_average AS difference_from_kept_average FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m ORDER BY difference_from_kept_average DESC, k.link_to_event ASC LIMIT 10
